source.author: verg
source.text: Aspice qui coeant populi, quae moenia clausis ferrum acuant portis in me exscidiumque meorum.
source.text_original: Aspice qui coeant populi, quae moenia clausis / ferrum acuant portis in me exscidiumque meorum.'
source.text_english: Look, what peoples are gathering, what walls, with the gates shut, are sharpening their swords against me and the destruction of my people.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: ne Peliae te vota trahant: ille aspera iussa repperit et Colchos in me luctumque meorum:
reuse.text_original: ne Peliae te vota trahant: ille aspera iussa / repperit et Colchos in me luctumque meorum: /
reuse.text_english: Do not let Pelias’s prayers draw you away: he devised harsh commands and the Colchians, and for me grief for my own people.
